title: The truth Hornet hid from the Knight in Hollow Knight
subject: hornet
description:
Did you realize Hornet knew all along? 👇

Hornet's lines in the Abyss and at the Black Egg Temple reveal who the Knight really is to her. Spoilers for Hollow Knight.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Cherry. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Hornet met the Knight five times and only ever called it ghost.
They shared a father. The Knight was a vessel, made in the Abyss to be hollow.
When it climbed back out, Hornet was waiting at the top.
"I see you've faced the place of your birth," she said.
At the Black Egg Temple she stopped at the door. That space, she said, was built for the Knight's kind.
When Hornet joins the final fight, the achievement names them: Sealed Siblings.
Skip the Dream Nail, and both of them are locked inside the temple together.
